copy.tagline: 掌握会计知识，从基础记账到专业实践
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要会计知识和实践指导
copy.tagline_en: Master accounting knowledge, from basic bookkeeping to professional practice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need accounting knowledge and practical guidance

howto.what: Claude会根据你的身份（小企业主、学生、专业人士等）和问题深度，提供从基础记账到专业会计的适应性指导。它会优先询问司法管辖区和实体类型，确保建议准确。
howto.when: 当你提出会计、税务或财务报表相关问题（如分录、报表分析、准则差异等）时自动触发。

say.text: 帮我解释一下应收账款周转率
say.note: Claude会结合小企业场景给出实际影响分析

say.text: 作为小企业主，我需要了解哪些税务要点？
say.note: Claude会询问你的司法管辖区和实体类型后给出具体建议

say.text: 演示一笔正确的会计分录格式

howto.what_en: Claude adapts guidance based on your role (small business owner, student, professional, etc.) and question depth, from basic bookkeeping to professional accounting. It always asks for your jurisdiction and entity type before giving specific advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about accounting, tax, or financial reporting topics such as journal entries, statement analysis, or GAAP/IFRS differences.

say_en.text: What tax tips for a small business owner?
say_en.note: Claude asks jurisdiction and entity type first

say_en.text: Show a proper journal entry format
say_en.note: Claude shows debits first, credits indented with names and amounts
